verdicts.reason: A: left-to-right banner layout works and text stays readable, but the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has moved below the body copy, which breaks the original reading order. The bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and there is a wide dead gap between the text block and the Shop Sale button. B: it has the same reordering, but 'WEEKEND ONLY' has shrunk to unreadable fine print and floats far below the body copy. The bottle is even more jammed against the canvas edges, so B is clearly worse on readability.
